project: Wuxia Life Early Childhood Agency Mechanics (Stage-1)
description: Stage-1 runtime/API agency mechanics: ages 0–4 use passive progression (no daily planning), infant stat clamps, period summaries with narrative + stat deltas, and local/API parity via HeadlessEngineSessionImpl. PRD status is implemented—stories serve as baseline verification or gap closure. See docs/PRD/early-childhood-agency-mechanics.md for product truth.

userStories.title: Extend session contracts for passive phases
userStories.description: As a developer, I need SessionPhase and ProgressionAckKind to include passive progression vocabulary so server and client share one phase model.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionPhase union includes passive_progression and period_summary (in addition to existing phases)
ProgressionAckKind includes passive_continue and period_summary
Types exported from src/contracts/sessionProgression.ts (or equivalent shared contracts path)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD US-001; frozen decisions §3; FR-2 passive ack authoritative on server

userStories.title: Lock childhood agency age-band constants
userStories.description: As a player, I want ages 0–4 to never be offered daily planning so that infant play matches age-appropriate agency.
acceptanceCriteria: childhoodAgency.ts defines INFANT_MAX_AGE=2 and DAILY_PLANNING_MIN_AGE=5
shouldOfferDailyPlanning returns false for ages 0–4
shouldOfferDailyPlanning returns true from age 5 per lite planning rules in childhoodAgency.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD Goals §2; frozen decisions §3; FR-1 ages 0–4 must not expose active_planning with non-empty options

userStories.title: Implement passive session phase resolution
userStories.description: As a player, I want ages 0–4 to advance via passive continuation when no story event or summary is pending.
acceptanceCriteria: getSessionPhase returns passive_progression when age < 5 and no pending story_event or period_summary
resolveChildhoodActionPalette returns [] for ages 0–4
p72SessionPhase.test.ts covers age 1 passive_progression case
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement passive childhood tick and period summary payload
userStories.description: As a player, I want each passive season to advance time and produce a summary of what happened before I continue.
acceptanceCriteria: executePassiveChildhoodTick advances exactly 1 quarter and writes eventHistory entry
periodSummaryBuilder builds periodSummary with narrative and actual stat deltas
SessionProgressionPayload includes periodSummary and passiveNarrative fields
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD US-002; Goals §2 period_summary with narrative + stat delta; touchpoints periodSummaryBuilder.ts, sessionProgression.ts

userStories.title: Wire headless session passive ack flow
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want HeadlessEngineSessionImpl to authoritatively drive passive progression and period_summary acks for API mode.
acceptanceCriteria: HeadlessEngineSessionImpl branches on shouldOfferDailyPlanning like local engine
Passive ack kinds passive_continue and period_summary are handled server-side (not UI-only)
sessionProgressionMapper maps passive phases and periodSummary to API response DTOs
Ages 0–4 API responses never return active_planning with non-empty planningOptions
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD US-002, US-005; FR-1, FR-2; touchpoints HeadlessEngineSessionImpl.ts, server sessionProgressionMapper.ts

userStories.title: Apply infant age-band stat clamps at resolve time
userStories.description: As a player, I want infant stat changes limited to believable stats and magnitudes so early life does not jump chivalry or internal skill.
acceptanceCriteria: ageActionStatCaps.ts clamps infant band (age ≤ INFANT_MAX_AGE) to constitution, health, comprehension only
Infant stat delta magnitude capped at Δ≤1 per application
ActionResultResolver applies ageActionStatCaps clamps after roll (not display-only)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD US-003; Goals §2; frozen decisions §3 infant allowed stats; FR-3 stat clamps at resolve time

userStories.title: Guard infant origin and training stat grants
userStories.description: As a player, I want birth phenomena and infant training to respect stat clamps so age 0 does not grant impossible martial stats.
acceptanceCriteria: birth_with_phenomenon at age 0 does not grant internalSkill+5 (flags/comprehension only)
p16OriginDestinyTests assert infant training yields chivalry=0 and internalSkill=0
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD US-003; Goals §2 ages 0–2 forbid chivalry/internalSkill/power jumps from actions or passive settlement

acceptanceCriteria: infantPassiveNarratives.ts catalog entries include origin tags and age bands
selectPassiveNarrative weights selection by origin flags on player state
Passive tick uses catalog narrative when no story event is selected

userStories.notes: PRD US-004; touchpoints infantPassiveNarratives.ts; non-goals §6 exclude Stage-3/4 quest chains and spine density

userStories.notes: PRD US-002; touchpoints GameScreen.vue, App.vue; non-goals §6 exclude Stage-4 lite 2-choice UI redesign for ages 5–7
